articles.title: Triton: DirectX 11 Driver for QEMU
articles.summary: Triton is a new Windows driver that brings full DirectX 11 support to QEMU virtual machines by serializing Direct3D API calls across the hypervisor boundary and loading them into the guest operating system. This allows for modern graphics acceleration on Windows guests without requiring anti-cheat software or modifying the host's system files. Triton achieves this by building a new driver that implements DirectX 11 DDI (Device Driver Interface) interfaces, which are used to communicate with the system Direct3D and DXGI libraries. By using these interfaces, Triton enables smooth graphics performance on Linux guests running games like Crash Bandicoot Trilogy through QEMU.
